The '''Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented''' was a sanatorium located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]]. It housed [[Naat Lare]] for five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] until his disappearance.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bedlam is English slang for an insane asylum, or wild chaotic behavior in general. It allegedly originates from a Cockney pronunciation of [[wikipedia:Bethlem Royal Hospital|Bethlem Royal Hospital]] in London.
